title: Add recommended deployment options to deployment docs
body:
Our current deployment docs lists many options for deploying Dask clusters. This PR keeps the same list, but adds recommended options for each category:

- HPC --> dask-jobqueue
- Cloud --> coiled
- Kubernetes --> dask-kubernetes operator
- Managed --> coiled

I've also added a few, mostly stylistic updates to the "Cloud" subpage in the deployment docs (e.g. added an image with cloud provider logos, added sphinx tabs in a couple of places) 

cc @quasiben
